lines.text: Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and the disciples followed Him.
Jesus knelt a stone's throw away and prayed, and an angel from heaven strengthened Him.
Jesus returned from prayer and found the disciples asleep, exhausted from travel, and told them to get up and pray.
A crowd led by Judas arrived, and one of Jesus's men cut off the high priest's servant's left ear.
Jesus asked the chief priests, temple officers, and elders if they came with swords and clubs as against an outlaw.
